To open a new ticket, provide the subject and message properties. Each new ticket uses one ticket from the quota of your support seat. To update an existing ticket with a comment, provide the hash of the ticket and the message. A comment on a closed ticket opens the ticket again, unless you set close to true. You can attach a project, backtest, live deployment, or AI conversation only when you open a new ticket. When you attach any of them, you give the QuantConnect Support Staff permission to view your project and all its libraries. When you comment on a ticket, the endpoint ignores these properties. You must have a support seat in the organization to use this endpoint.
